comments.body: I've seen it during my days as a language teacher, and from more unfamiliar languages. If you study full time, have enough money for a teacher, and take it at least semi-seriously it can be done. I had a Russian kid take 10 hours of private lessons weekly for around 8 months and went from nearly 0 English to fluent - just studied with me and played video games all day in English. Wanted to escape before conscription and go to a western union- did it too.
comments.author: kitten_twinkletoes
